description.en: A whole Tylosaurus proriger reconstruction with four paddles and a swimming tail. It combines multiple sources; soft tissues, paddle edges, tail-fin shape and colour are inferred rather than preserved together in one specimen.
description.zh: Tylosaurus proriger的完整复原，具有四桨肢与游泳尾。综合多项材料，软组织、桨缘、尾鳍外形和颜色为推断，并非同一标本共同保存。

evidence_anchors.rostrum: Stewart and Mallon2018 Fig1A CMN8162 real skull with8cm photographic scale; Fig1B10cm drawing separately labeled. p77 text42mm toothless premaxillary rostrum before first premaxillary teeth. Rounded blunt tip, not a tusk or horn. Independent subadult material, used qualitatively.
evidence_anchors.scale: Everhart2006 Paludicola5(4):170–183 p178 explicitly identifies USNM8898 T.proriger approximately9m, citing his2004 study. Scale approximate only; component lengths inferred.
evidence_anchors.taxonomy: AMNH2026 news distinguishes T.rex and reassigns Bunker/Sophie; those specimens and old >12m generalizations excluded. Existing traditional T.proriger evidence retained, no claim full2026 matrix read.
evidence_anchors.whole: Ryan Somma Smithsonian mounted T.proriger photograph actually viewed; skull, ribcage, limbs and long caudal column visible, oblique mount and terminal tail at image edge. AMNH FR221 supplementary true photo viewed, tail cropped and not a complete silhouette.

morphology: Long powerful but streamlined trunk, short neck, elongated tapering head; no external gills, crocodile dorsal scutes or dorsal back fin.

Main gate: rounded blunt premaxillary rostral tip extends visibly anterior to tooth row. No teeth in foremost0.10m nominal upper tip. Lower jaw also ends with a short tooth-free symphyseal front, not fangs at the extreme snout. Do not turn this into needle rostrum, tusk or ram horn.

Conical recurved teeth begin behind blunt rostral tip, moderate jaw opening12degrees shows gate. Simplified12visibleteethperjawside is rendering choice, not dental formula. Temporal skull openings covered by flesh.
Four broad fleshed paddles supported by limb skeletons, fore somewhat larger than hind. Distinct shoulder and hip roots; no exposed individual land digits or turtle claws.

Long laterally compressed tail, deeper proximal section and tapered caudal peduncle, with a restrained hypocercal fin: vertebral/lower lobe bends ventrally, upper lobe soft tissue inferred from related mosasaurs, not directly preserved in these Tylosaurus sources. No whale horizontal flukes or giant symmetrical crescent.
Muted dark slate back and pale ventrum artistic inference. Do not copy mounted fossil arched dorsal pose or matrix texture; gentle swimming posture only.

original_scope.en: Planned animal asset: elongate toothless rostral tip preceding the toothed jaws.
original_scope.zh: 规划中的动物资产：有齿颌前方延伸的无齿吻端。

scale.interpretation: Nominal9m axial length. All subdivisions are inference, not specimen measurements. Rostrum about9%head length is a conservative adult modeling target, not copied from juvenile42mm. Adjust within scientifically supported silhouette, preserving conspicuous tooth-free rounded premaxillary tip.

scientific_limits.en: USNM8898 about9m is a published estimate in Everhart2006p178, not a direct measurement of the photograph. Smithsonian photo metadata identifies T.proriger with plesiosaur stomach contents, consistent with8898, but accession is not legible in photo: association is an inference, not proven label reading. Mounted skeleton includes restoration and pose distortion; do not copy its arched back or upturned tail. CMN8162 is a separate subadult skull with negatively allometric rostrum, so its42mm rostrum is NOT directly scaled into an adult measurement. Soft tissue, paddle outlines, caudal fin, body volumes and color inferred. 2018 table8898 skull710mm conflicts with other apparent size cues and is excluded from metric authority. Giant Bunker/Sophie material reassigned T.rex2026 is excluded.
scientific_limits.zh: USNM8898约9米是Everhart2006第178页文献估计，不是照片实测。Smithsonian图说明为胃含蛇颈龙的T.proriger，与8898相符，但图中馆藏号不可读，关联仅推断。展架有修复和姿态扭曲，不复制拱背和上翘尾。CMN8162是另一亚成年头骨，吻端负异速生长，42毫米不能直接放大成成体测量。软组织、桨肢轮廓、尾鳍、体积和颜色推定。2018表中8898头长710毫米有矛盾，排除量尺用途。2026改定T.rex的Bunker/Sophie巨型材料不用。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Whole living Tylosaurus proriger, retaining original genus ID and complete head, trunk, four paddles and swimming tail. Species-level multi-material reconstruction, not a single-specimen digital twin.

acceptance: Lateral front view clearly separates rounded edentulous tip from first tooth and jaw opening.
Top view shows blunt narrow snout widening to skull rear and all four paddles.
Head-on side view verifies head/body depth and no pencil-thin needle tip.
Perspective keeps whole tail/paddles visible and retains rostral gate at useful preview size.
shape_gate.comparisons: Platecarpus has a proportionally smaller shorter head and no projecting tooth-free rostral knob. Tylosaurus must not pass by scaling/recoloring Platecarpus. Ichthyosaurs have large eyes, needle-like fully toothed jaws and different tail bend; no dolphin-like clone.
shape_gate.required_combination: Long blunt tooth-free rostral projection preceding toothed long jaws, robust elongated trunk, four paddles and long compressed swimming tail. Whole organism retained.
